scope: Real Clerk, Cloudflare staging D1, a separately deployed Cloudflare receiver, and scheduled retry. The receiver intentionally returned 503 on the first valid signature and 204 on retry; no manual second dispatch.
limits: Controlled receiver failure demonstrates bounded at-least-once behavior. Concurrent cancellation/erasure, private URLs, redirects and quota exhaustion are tested separately in the isolated runtime. This does not promise exactly-once external side effects.
